source: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team — Sinister Woods. PMD Red contains 12 procedural floors plus fixed/event floor 13 (D04P02). The current New Era definition is under canonical reconciliation; adaptations must not be presented as ROM-identical.

status.reason: 130/130 native map generations passed. Active PMDO route loaded D04P01, 12 procedural floors with logged seeds/stairs, midpoint, D04P02, the 3-boss fixed map with its native LuaCheckBossClearEvent hook, native segment exits/EndGame, and Metano Town. Route harness simulates the cleared boss outcome; player-input combat replay remains a separately documented limitation.
